fields: ATP free energy expressed in thermal-energy units (M = dG_ATP / R T)
M = dG_ATP / (R T) = 20.94: the free energy delivered by one ATP (54 kJ/mol at 310.15 K), expressed as a multiple of the thermal energy k_B T. It is described as the coin's size in thermal kicks.
It enters IAM's Law as 'the coin in kicks' — the reserve-to-noise ratio that sets how large the maintenance 'payment' is compared with the constant thermal kicks hitting every mark.

It sets the coin's size in thermal kicks for IAM-A (how well the cell holds its record, against its own physics). From it the register derives the floor eps_floor = 1/(1 + e^M) (the floor (the best one coin can hold against heat), DERIVED): the best one coin could ever do.
How it is obtained or computed

Computed directly from measured inputs: M = dG_ATP / (R T) = 54,000 / (8.314 x 310.15) = 20.94, using dG_ATP = 54 kJ/mol (the coin's size (the energy of one ATP), measured, nameplate) and T = 310.15 K (the cell's temperature, measured).

M enters IAM's Law at link 2 (long form section 2, 'the price': k_BT ln 2 per bit at the surface's own temperature). From M the register derives the floor eps_floor = 1/(1 + e^M) (the floor (the best one coin can hold against heat), DERIVED). M itself rests on two measured inputs: dG_ATP = 54 kJ/mol (the coin's size (the energy of one ATP), measured, nameplate) and T = 310.15 K (the cell's temperature, measured).
Healthy value and how it is set

Its value is fixed at M = 20.94, set from the measured nameplate value dG_ATP = 54 kJ/mol (the coin's size (the energy of one ATP)) at the measured cell temperature T = 310.15 K; source_kind: set per cell type or fixed, from a cited measurement.

fields: Predicted baseline maintenance-methylation error rate per CpG (physics-only intercept, before any fitted line)
The held error a healthy cell should show from physics alone at a given CpG, derived from the odds of a slow, steady two-coin close: odds (w = 2M) = 21.45 -> eps0 = 0.04454.
It enters the driven passage (slow-write rule, x = 2M) as the baseline intercept term against which observed held error is compared.

The instrument (IAM-A) needs this physics-derived baseline so that it can compare a sample's observed held error against what the cell's own physics predicts, rather than against an arbitrary or assumed value.
How it is obtained or computed
Computed as: odds = (w/2)/(1 - (1 - e^-w)/w), with w = 2M = 41.88, giving odds 21.45; then eps0 = 1/(1 + odds) = 0.04454.

This is part of IAM's Law, link 1d (long form section 1d: the hold is the same rule, slow — the slow-write rule). That section states the maintained hold follows the function held/lost = (x/2)/(1-(1-e^-x)/x), derived for the cell's restore at x = w = 2M = 41.9, giving odds 21.45, E_hold = 3.066 kT, and phi = 0.1464 ~ ln M/M. Status: derived (from M, the derived 2-ATP price and the derived ceiling; status raised).

Its value is fixed by the physics at 0.04454 (from M alone); the source_kind notes it is derived by IAM's Law, fixed by the physics, with a setting used only to test what-if.

fields: IAM-A's self-reference line (line constants 0.0403 / 0.0346), card_key line_firm.
Self-reference baseline for predicted held (maintenance) error: the intercept and slope that convert a sample's own loose-CpG share into its expected error.

eps_pred(L) = 0.0403 + 0.0346 x L, where L is the sample's own loose (intermediate-methylation) share. This is each library's own prediction of held error, built from its own looseness: the self-reference.

It turns a sample's loose share L into the held-error value a healthy cell of that same looseness would be expected to show. IAM-A then divides the sample's observed held error by this predicted value.

IAM-A needs an expectation tailored to the sample's own looseness, not a single fixed number, so that the observed-over-predicted ratio (1 is healthy; above 1 means marks are being lost on molecules the cell holds firmly) isolates failed maintenance after DNA replication (DNMT1 with UHRF1) rather than ordinary background loss.
How it is obtained or computed

Computed from the formula eps_pred(L) = 0.0403 + 0.0346 x L, entering the chain's runtime line at code_ref stage_q2_selfref.predict. Basis: measured (the slope of IAM-A's line with loose share), within-sample part derived. The register's own slope figure for this line is given separately as 0.034625 per unit loose share (the slope of IAM-A's line with loose share, 'Baseline slope'), with the within-sample part derived from the pump and replicated in a second laborat[ory] (text as recorded); the intercept (the law's held error as IAM-A's counter counts it) is derived from M alone (intercept the held error set by the coin and the two-coin push) and a blind test a recorded test MET with the eraser shar[e] (text as recorded).

This sits in IAM's Law, link 1d (long-form section 1d, 'the maintained hold is the same rule, slow'): held/lost = (x/2)/(1-(1-e^{-x})/x), derived for the cell's restore with x = w = 2M, giving odds 21.45, E_hold = 3.066 kT, phi = 0.1464. Status per the long form: identity confirmed symbolically on GitHub (run 44662887227; sudden limit odds = 1). Within that frame, the intercept (the law's held error as IAM-A's counter counts it) is DERIVED from M alone (intercept the held error set by the coin and the two-coin push), passing a blind test a recorded test MET with the eraser share, and the slope is PARTLY DERIVED, its within-sample part coming from the pump and replicated in a second laborat[ory] (source text ends here).

fields: Molecule-inclusion and isolated-loss calling rule for read-level discordance
A molecule counts if >= 80 % methylated; a loss counts only with both neighbors marked.

Sets which molecules and which losses enter IAM-A's count (feeding QUAL_MIN_METH, QUAL_MIN_CALLS): only reads at or above 80 % methylated are counted, and within those, an unmethylated CpG counts as a loss only when both its neighboring CpGs are marked.

So the meter's ends and loosely held molecules do not fake losses — IAM-A's job is counting isolated unmethylated CpGs against the sample's own prediction, and this rule keeps that count to genuinely isolated losses on molecules the cell is otherwise holding firmly.
How it is obtained or computed
It is a rule, not measured: a fixed chain-rule setting (basis 'rule', source_kind 'setting with a default (a chain rule)'), carried in code as stage_q2_selfref.QUAL_MAX_METH.

record.job: how well the cell holds its record, against its own physics
record.law: IAM's Law, step 1 (Actualization): a sudden write of an einselected pointer into a blank Gaussian surface splits the energy exactly: held = spent = U = k_BT times the two relative entropies. Status: DERIVED GIVEN the four write conditions (sudden, no opposing record, Gaussian, einselected). IAM's Law, step 1d (The maintained hold (the slow write)): held/lost = (x/2)/(1 - (1 - e^-x)/x); sudden x -> 0 kept = lost; the cell at x = 2M: odds 21.45, E_hold 3.066 kT, phi = 0.1464 ~ ln M/M. Status: DERIVED (identity). IAM's Law, step 2 (The price): each nat costs at least k_BT held and k_BT spent; k_BT ln 2 per bit is the floor, paid at the receiving surface's own T. Status: DERIVED (Landauer) for the floor. IAM's Law, step 2b (The funding): the payment is free energy degraded to heat, traced to the low-entropy start (ATP <- food <- sunlight; stars <- fusion and contraction). Status: DERIVED given the Past Hypothesis, which is a postulate of established physics too (gap 16, not closable).

fields: Per-type band (each cell type's own healthy level's measured substitute)
Cell-type-specific healthy reference band for the IAM-A maintenance-fidelity score: a 95 % prediction interval (t x s x sqrt(1 + 1/n))

A band set around each cell type's own healthy center (the median A_derived of that type's healthy atlas libraries) plus or minus t(0.975, df) x s x sqrt(1 + 1/n), where s is the pooled within-type spread; half-width median 0.085. It replaces one shared healthy window with a separate one for each cell type.
It judges each cell type's held error against its own healthy level rather than against one window used for every type, so a sample reads as inside or outside its own type's normal operating range.

IAM's Law derives the line's intercept from M, but each type's own offset (each cell type's own healthy level) is still an open, measured-not-derived item (each cell type's own healthy level: 'OPEN, the deciding item'), so the instrument needs a measured per-type band to stand in for that missing derivation.
How it is obtained or computed

Computed by the chain (stage_law_sphere.hold_alarm, type_positions_v1.json) as lo, hi = m (1 -/+ t_{0.975,94} x 0.035 x sqrt(1 + 1/n)), with m the type's healthy center (median A_derived of its healthy atlas libraries) and s = 0.035 the pooled within-type spread; half-width median 0.085.

fields: On every read at least 80 % methylated (a held molecule), count each unmethylated CpG with methylated neighbors on both sides (an isolated loss) and the chances for one: the held error. Count the sample's share of loosely held molecules: the loose share. The healthy line predicts the held error of a healthy cell of that looseness: held = 0.0403 + 0.0346 x loose share (commissioned line). IAM-A = observed held error / predicted. A_derived uses the derived line (intercept 0.04454 from M alone). Refused for mixtures (then IAM-A in the mix, development). Since a chain update IAM-A is read on every sample: a sample outside its type's healthy shape, or of a type with no shape reference, is read and flagged beside A, never stopped.

A held molecule is one the cell actively maintains, so a loss on it is a maintenance failure (DNMT1 with UHRF1 after replication), not a cell-type difference. Reading against the sample's own loose share removes the cell type's and the laboratory's general level, so no healthy samples from the same run are needed (the 2026-11-07 reference rule) and every sample is its own standard.

IAM's Law in the cell (links 1, 1d, 2, 2b): the floor of held error is where thermal kicks beat one full coin, 1/(1 + e^M), M = dG_ATP / RT = 20.94 (derived); one restore costs one SAM = 2 ATP (derived, adenylate kinase at equilibrium); the best hold two coins buy is a constant push (derived ceiling); hence the held error from M alone, 0.04454 per site (derived intercept). The slope is partly derived (its within-sample part from the pump; replicated in a second laboratory). Each cell type's own level is not derived: it is measured from the atlas's healthy libraries and used as a substitute, labeled as such.

The sample's molecules (pat file: one row per read and its CpG pattern) - nothing else. The line constants 0.0403 / 0.0346 and the derived intercept 0.04454 from the chain (stage_q2_selfref). For A_derived's state: each type's measured healthy position (type_positions_v1.json, 56 types, from the IAM Sequencing Atlas's healthy libraries, GSE186458).

Band v1 (commissioned): Normal 0.7787-1.0551. Commissioning test, a laboratory IAM-A had never seen (GSE144691, sorted human CD8 T-cell subsets): 7 of 8 read samples Normal against a sealed bar of 0.75 with at least 8 read; the shape check declined 5 of 13 (four naive, one central memory). Band v2 (pooled, in commissioning): 0.8744-1.1783 from 150 atlas readings; pooled within-type spread s = 0.035 (94 df). Per-type band (the substitute): 113 of 123 healthy libraries inside with each donor left out (91.9 %, built for 95 %); out of sample, 40 of 41 healthy libraries that built neither band within (hold alarm, jackknife floor).

Per-type band = the type's healthy center +/- t(0.975, df) x s x sqrt(1 + 1/n) (a Student's t prediction interval for one new library; GUM type A). The out-of-sample floor is a block jackknife over the Law Sphere's units (it measured spread about four times plain counting noise). Bars come from measured spread, never a chosen number.

Relay test (2026-11-20, test library GSM5652214, through the one button): planted single losses on held molecules moved IAM-A and no other instrument's main reading (partly met: the counter's pooled run ratio was blind to planted runs, fixed by a chain update run excess by length). Known-answer runs on the test library after every chain edit since 11-20: IAM-A unchanged.

(1) Each type's own healthy level is measured, not derived: IAM-A_derived's state rests on that substitute. (2) Coverage 91.9 % against 95 %: the within-type spread is a little underestimated; lab-to-lab scatter inside a type (about -5 %) is not in the band. (3) Commissioned only on blood CD8 T cells; other types are development. (4) Needs reads long enough to hold three CpGs; shallow libraries carry more counting error (reported). (5) Mixtures are not read by plain IAM-A. A genetic variant at a CpG (C to T) reads as a lost mark on every molecule that carries it; its share of IAM-A's held errors across the genome is being measured; one such site in the known-answer library left IAM-A at 0.949.

records.name: IAM-A: how it tares (against the sample's own line) and how it is defended
questions: Why doesn't IAM-A need healthy controls?

It reads each sample against its own loose share: the line says what held error a healthy cell of that looseness makes, so the sample's own data set the expectation. The healthy atlas is used only to build the line once.

Counting noise is part of it and is reported (IAM-A's own counting error). The loss is counted only on reads at least 80 % methylated and only for an unmethylated CpG with methylated neighbors on both sides; incomplete bisulfite conversion makes false methylated calls, not losses; the counter's response to clustering and molecule ends is calibrated. Separating every technical source of single losses is still open.
Which parts are derived and which measured?

Derived: the floor 1/(1 + e^M) with M = 20.94, the 2-ATP price, the ceiling, the intercept 0.04454. Partly derived: the slope. Measured: the coin dG_ATP 54 kJ/mol, 310.15 K, the band, and each type's own level.
Was it tested on data it never saw?
Yes: commissioned on a second laboratory's CD8 T cells (GSE144691), 7 of 8 Normal against a bar sealed in advance; the per-type check read 40 of 41 held-out healthy libraries within.
What does IAM-A above 1 mean biologically?

More marks lost on molecules the cell holds firmly than its own looseness predicts: in the field's terms, reduced maintenance-methylation fidelity after replication (DNMT1 with UHRF1). Whether IAM-A also separates active demethylation (TET) is not yet tested; the planned test is the UHRF1 knockout pair in GSE116229.
From measured healthy spread with a Student's t prediction interval (GUM type A), never a chosen number; band v1 0.779-1.055 is commissioned, the per-type band is the development substitute.
